title: Eco-Environmental Code of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国生态环境法典), including Book 4 on green and low-carbon development (绿色低碳发展编)
citation: Order of the President No. 70 (中华人民共和国主席令第七十号), adopted 2026-03-12 at the Fourth Session of the 14th National People's Congress
evidence: Art. 1242 (last article): "本法自2026年8月15日起施行。《中华人民共和国环境保护法》、《中华人民共和国环境影响评价法》、《中华人民共和国海洋环境保护法》、《中华人民共和国大气污染防治法》、《中华人民共和国水污染防治法》、《中华人民共和国土壤污染防治法》、《中华人民共和国固体废物污染环境防治法》、《中华人民共和国噪声污染防治法》、《中华人民共和国放射性污染防治法》、《中华人民共和国清洁生产促进法》同时废止。" Header line: "（2026年3月12日第十四届全国人民代表大会第四次会议通过）". Opened the docx via https://flk.npc.gov.cn/law-search/download/pc?format=docx&bbbs=96630961659b4d87a65b7b1c595097fa on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is the whole Code (five books: general provisions, pollution prevention, ecological protection, green and low-carbon development, legal liability and supplementary provisions), including the table of contents as published. The flk page lists the President's order No. 70 as a related document. One version exists on flk. No framework climate law is in force (see the register row for the Climate Change Law draft); the Code's Book 4 is the nearest instrument. No government English translation found: english.www.gov.cn (home page opened 200), a web search for an official English text, and the npc.gov.cn English pages (npc.gov.cn refused the cloud address with a TLS handshake failure) were tried; the English texts that turned up are on WIPO Lex, law firms and commercial databases, which are not stored.

title: Environmental Protection Law of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国环境保护法), 2014 revision
citation: Adopted 1989-12-26, revised 2014-04-24 at the 8th Session of the Standing Committee of the 12th NPC
evidence: Art. 70: "本法自2015年1月1日起施行。" Repealed by Art. 1242 of the Eco-Environmental Code (cn-ecology-code): "本法自2026年8月15日起施行。《中华人民共和国环境保护法》、《中华人民共和国环境影响评价法》……同时废止。" Opened on flk on 2026-11-02 (flk marks the entry as no longer effective).
notes: Two records: the 2014 revision as in force from 2015-01-01 and a repeal record dated 2026-08-15. flk serves no other version of this Law (the 1989 original is not listed as a separate item, and the 2014 revision is the only national item with this title). The 2014 text is the version in force until 2026-08-14. No government English translation found: english.www.gov.cn (home page opened 200), a web search for an official English text, and the npc.gov.cn English pages (npc.gov.cn refused the cloud address with a TLS handshake failure) were tried; the English texts that turned up are on WIPO Lex, law firms and commercial databases, which are not stored.
status_note: Repealed on 2026-08-15 by Art. 1242 of the Eco-Environmental Code (cn-ecology-code).

title: Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国反不正当竞争法), 2025 revision
citation: Adopted 1993-09-02; revised 2017-11-04, amended 2019-04-23, second revision 2025-06-27 at the 16th Session of the Standing Committee of the 14th NPC
evidence: Art. 32 of the 2017 revision: "本法自2018年1月1日起施行。" Art. 41 of the 2025 revision: "本法自2025年10月15日起施行。" Header of the 2025 text lists the 1993, 2017 (first revision), 2019 (amendment) and 2025 (second revision) steps. Opened on flk on 2026-11-02.
notes: Three records: 2018-01-01 (2017 revision, adopted), 2019-04-23 (2019 amendment, consolidated), 2025-10-15 (2025 revision, adopted). The 1993 original is not served on flk, and its first in-force date is not stated on a page opened, so the entry's date is that of the first stored version. Art. 9 (false or misleading commercial publicity) and Art. 25 (fine up to CNY 1,000,000, up to 2,000,000 where serious) of the 2025 text are the provisions that reach environmental claims; whether a given claim falls under them is not assessed. No government English translation found: english.www.gov.cn (home page opened 200), a web search for an official English text, and the npc.gov.cn English pages (npc.gov.cn refused the cloud address with a TLS handshake failure) were tried; the English texts that turned up are on WIPO Lex, law firms and commercial databases, which are not stored.

title: Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国广告法), Art. 28 false advertising
evidence: Art. 74 (2021 text) and Art. 75 (2015 and 2018 texts): "本法自2015年9月1日起施行。" Art. 28: "广告以虚假或者引人误解的内容欺骗、误导消费者的，构成虚假广告。" Opened on flk on 2026-11-02.
notes: Three records, each the whole Law: 2015-09-01 (2015 revision, adopted), 2018-10-26 (first amendment, consolidated), 2021-04-29 (second amendment, consolidated). The 1994 original is not served on flk. Art. 28 is the false-advertising umbrella; the Law has no environmental-claim provision of its own.
